entities.summary: David Christopher DeJesus is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals, Oakland Athletics, Chicago Cubs, Washington Nationals, Tampa Bay Rays and Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim. DeJesus, who is of Puerto Rican descent, and was an analyst for the Cubs with NBC Sports Chicago from 2017–2019.
